thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: Founders: how do you manage sleep and burnout while building?
thread_summary: Look for a founder asking how others keep health and sleep intact during a launch or crunch.
text: We launched a supplement brand last month, so we know this one. What helped our founder: a fixed wake time even after a bad night, no calls after 9 PM unless something is on fire, and one hard task done before noon. Sleep went first when he let it slide, and decisions the next day got worse. Treat sleep like a meeting you don't cancel.
why: Founder-friendly subreddit where saying who we are is welcome, and the story is relatable.
